tasks.prompt: The table below presents the number of children ever born to women aged 40-44 years in Australia for each year the information was collected since 1981.
instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

tasks.prompt: Tourism is encouraged in many countries. Does tourism bring more advantages or disadvantages to a country?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
